headlines.title: Sean Grayson, ex-deputy convicted of fatally shooting Sonya Massey, dies, attorney says
headlines.description: Grayson was diagnosed with Stage 3 colon cancer in 2023, one of his attorneys said previously. It was unclear if that is what caused his death.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney called steep new U.S. tariffs on a wide swath of his country’s goods “a miscalculation” after trade talks with Canada collapsed.

headlines.title: Father of sailor aboard USS Abraham Lincoln detained by immigration authorities, family says
headlines.description: Joshua Aviles said he has been “fighting for a country that has given me everything,” only to learn his father had been detained.

headlines.title: Out-of-control wildfire forces evacuations
headlines.description: A fast-moving wildfire explodes outside Reno, Nevada, scorching over 15-thousand acres and forcing tens of thousands to evacuate. NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Tim Scott says ‘without question’ Darline Graham is qualified for Senate
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. Tim Scott (R-S.C.) says Sen. Darline Graham is “ready for primetime” ahead of South Carolina’s Republican runoff on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Kyle Kirkwood wins IndyCar race in downtown D.C. celebrating U.S. 250th birthday
headlines.description: Reaching top speeds of about 180 mph, the cars zipped down Pennsylvania Ave between the Capitol and the White House.

headlines.title: Mark Ruffalo denies antisemitism charge from Paramount Skydance over merger criticism
headlines.description: The actor fired back at Paramount’s response to his criticisms of the company’s planned merger with rival Warner Bros.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: French tourist dies in Death Valley heat after vehicle gets stuck in mud
headlines.description: A French tourist died last week in California’s Death Valley after the vehicle he was in got stuck in mud and he ventured away for help amid temperatures that reached 116 degrees, officials said.
